invariant: Every USymbolCloud segment constructs CoordinateChange, whose length is XPoint2D.distance: Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy). That operation order can affect unit vectors and integer bubble counts, but it is not the source of the observed 171 by 99 cluster divergence.
causal_divergence: Disproved by implementation and exact rerun: replacing every cloud f64::hypot call with Java's multiply-add-then-sqrt expression left the residual path byte-for-byte unchanged. A JDK debugger trace subsequently showed the actual discontinuity: PlantUML's LimitFinder measurement pass calls USymbolCloud with width 171.0, while the translated final SVG pass calls it with 170.99999999999997 and therefore selects a different integer seed. Rust retained 171.0 across normalization.
planned_change: No production change is justified by this account. Revert the exploratory distance substitution and address the independently established post-normalization dimension mechanism in class-cluster-post-normalization-dimensions.
